g.text: What each program owns, what it keeps, and the imports that cross between them
the process a request lands in
tests per stack, parsed not run
The arrow that is no longer there
policy_dependency_graph used to import the hotel corpus, so the abstract layer sat on the scenario layer. The
projection now lives in policy_demo_graph.py, which imports both sides; the graph module imports neither the demo
nor its constants. Stack C is reached from :8083, so neither the graph nor the planner is an island — but nothing
imports app/*, and app/* imports nothing outside its own package. That handover isolation is a different decision,
not this one, and it is still open.
Read from the import statements in backend/ on 2026-10-31; test counts parsed from backend/tests.
